a: It refers to when there are 2 or more cards with the same level among all of the stacked cards.
Examples include when a level 5 Digimon has a level 5 digivolution card or when a level 6 Digimon has 2 level 5 digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards" mean, exactly?
Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect suspend a different card from the one that's given "can't unsuspend until the end of their turn"?
Can I activate this card's inherited effect even if my opponent's Digimon and the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards are deleted at the same timing?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, gain 1 memory.
